scope: Isolated newly added fixed-comparison insertion helper only; not full formal six-condition GUI or CI. Synthetic data; native Playwright Chromium/WebKit, not physical Safari.
build: Initial uncommitted Pages build completed 2026-10-26 around 11:00 UTC; see served-build-files.sha256. Not final commit identity.
limitations: Two keyboard Tab traversal assertions were added after these processes loaded their helper. They were not executed in these runs.
The subsequent evidence.error storage-capacity guard change was not in this served build. Final rebuilt artifact and exact final HEAD require separate formal CI verification.
These are two isolated 390px conditions, not the full 966-check / 568-geometry / 120-PNG formal six-condition suite.

Local adapter uses explicit native browser executable paths; no browser mocks or DOM body replacement. New preview PNGs here have no formal CI identity overlay; formal retained captures add the standard overlay.
Physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver and OS text enlargement/backgrounding were not tested. CSS 200% and emulated mobile contexts are not substitutes.
